Name: Busty Farmer Edited
Author: Avvvocado
Description:
All credit to ChewyZ for their excellent sprites and original mod. This is a version with a lot of edits to make everything look more natural that I made for myself. Adds bounce/ jiggle to actions (swinging axes, using the water can, etc.), fixes the boobs disappearing when sitting, and tweaks the running+walking animations. If there is any mistake or animation missed, feel free to tell me.

[img]https://images2.imgbox.com/79/b7/w7NMq17G_o.gif[/img]
[img]https://images2.imgbox.com/1b/6d/wW2vYHY1_o.gif[/img]
[img]https://images2.imgbox.com/3f/74/WMWV7xwD_o.gif[/img]

KNOWN INCOMPATIBILITY ISSUES:
-Get Glam: get glam causes the boobs to disappear when your farmer wears a bikini in the spa, a patched version is currently in the works
